property_summary: The transfer function should revert if any external call to transferFrom fails.
After transfer, the contract's transfer return value equals true (the call never reverts on failure).
The transfer function should revert if any external call to transferFrom fails.
After transfer, the total number of calls to caddress is at least _tos.length (the bug may silently skip some calls).
After calling transfer, the function returns true only if all internal calls succeeded, otherwise it reverts.
The transfer function should never revert if the recipient list is non-empty, regardless of the other parameters.
The transfer function should not revert when the _tos array length is greater than 0 and the sender address is not the zero address.
The transfer function should always revert when _tos array index equals _tos.length (out-of-bounds access).
The transfer function should not revert when _tos.length > 0 and the index i never exceeds _tos.length - 1 in the loop.
